title: Continuous-Variable MIMO THz Quantum Secret Sharing: Gaussian-modulation and Passive-modulation
summary: Although quantum key distribution (QKD) enables information-theoretically secure key distribution, it is mainly designed for point-to-point communication and cannot directly support multi-user collaborative scenarios. To address this limitation, quantum secret sharing (QSS) has been proposed to enable secure multiparty key sharing. However, most existing QSS protocols rely on a single-input single-output (SISO) channel, which limits the achievable secret key rate (SKR) and transmission distance.
